description: This file defines a Java interface 'FilePut' used for adding files to a store's content management system, providing method signatures for adding single or multiple content files.

classes.name: FilePut
classes.description: Java interface for file upload operations within the CMS module, declaring methods for adding one or multiple files.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single content file associated with a merchant store, taking store code and input content data; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple content files associated with a merchant store, taking store code and list of input content data; may throw ServiceException.
